STARLINK-31502 should maneuver; a narrow tie in the weighted scores (76 vs 75) was decided by its higher propellant reserve (78 % vs 41 %) and lower mission impact (15 % vs 45 %). The burn would give a miss distance of about 4 200 m and lower the collision probability to roughly 2.3 × 10⁻⁸. A human flight director must approve, and the fuel-reserve and mission-impact inputs are based on assumptions.
